name: Armenian Soviet Socialist Republic
native: Հայկական Սովետական Սոցիալիստական Հանրապետություն (Haykakan Sovetakan Sotsialistakan Hanrapetutyun)

predecessors.name: First Republic of Armenia
predecessors.text: Cliopatria's Armenia of 1919, the First Republic of Armenia (40,911 km2)

ledger.x: 1920, 29 November: "Soviet Armenia was established on 29 November 1920, with the Sovietisation of the short-lived First Republic of Armenia"; on 2 December Yerevan signed a pact with Moscow "securing Armenian statehood as a Soviet republic".
1922, March: the Armenian SSR enters the Transcaucasian federation.
1936, 5 December: "When the TSFSR was dissolved in 1936, Armenia became a constituent republic of the Soviet Union"; the name becomes Armenian Soviet Socialist Republic.
1990, 23 August: "Local authorities declared state sovereignty on 23 August 1990"; the formal name is declared Hayastani Hanrapetutyun.
1991, 21 September: "An independence referendum held on 21 September 1991 was supported by more than 99% of voters"; independence was recognised 26 December 1991.

certainty.note: Alexandropol talks with Turkey (December 1920) and the Treaty of Kars (13 October 1921) fixed the western border; the Zangezur and Karabakh lines are not on the pages opened.
Kars border with Turkey; the Azerbaijan border is the Soviet-era internal line, drawn as the modern one.
